title: Uptrendly App
description: UI/UX and product design for Uptrendly, a platform that connects brands with creators and supports influencer marketing campaigns. The project focused on improving the overall product experience while making the interface more consistent and scalable. Alongside redesigning key flows and screens, I reworked the existing component library into a structured design system and visual language that could support the product as it grew.

sections.title: Design Process
sections.body: I combined UX audits, user conversations, and reviews of key flows to identify recurring pain points. Findings were documented and translated into design improvements, then revisited as new features and updates were introduced.

images.caption: Notes made in FigJam for UX audit of various screens and flows.

sections.title: Design System
sections.body: I audited the existing design system to improve consistency across color, typography, and UI components. The system was then refined into a clearer visual language with reusable components that made the product easier to maintain and scale.
